observations.behavior: Adds requests.exceptions.JSONDecodeError to the tuple of exceptions caught in _build_url, alongside ChunkedEncodingError. This allows the retry mechanism to treat a JSON parsing failure as a transient error warranting a fresh request.
observations.posthog_connection: Retrying a warehouse connector request after a JSON parsing failure, rather than immediately raising an error, could recover from transient network or parsing issues without user intervention.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that when a 200 response has a truncated body causing JSONDecodeError, the connector retries and eventually succeeds with a fresh request.
observations.posthog_connection: This test does not change implementation, but it could help prevent regression of the behavior established in P1.F1.H1. It does not establish that the implementation exists or is complete.
